_comment: Golden set for the offline eval harness (ROADMAP 0.4.0). APPROVED by the owner.
Built from the ACTUAL corpus, without inventing legal content: each question is a
natural-language topic query and its ground_truth_sources are the real corpus
file(s) whose subject matter answers it (a factual law->topic mapping). Filenames
are exactly the sources present in db/. Questions q01-q15 are the known-good
acceptance_m1.py queries; the rest deepen coverage. Entries with type='abstention'
are OUT of the corpus on purpose (empty ground_truth_sources): they are DORMANT for
the deterministic retrieval gate (eval_harness skips them) and staged for the
deferred LLM-judge layer, which will check that the model declines instead of
inventing an answer. No abstention entry asserts any legal fact.
schemaVersion 2 (ROADMAP 0.9.0, Tramo A) adds optional ground_truth_fragments:
LITERAL strings copied out of the corpus file named in ground_truth_sources, used
to score whether the chunk that actually answers came back, not merely the right
law. They invent nothing — test_eval_harness asserts every fragment appears
verbatim in its source file, so an invented one fails the suite. Strings are kept
short because ingest chunks at ~500 chars and a long quote can straddle a boundary.
fragmentsApproved was signed off by the owner on 2026-08-11.
